tools.name: list_poems
tools.description: Start here. Shows what's on the shelves (collections, themes, moods, forms, with counts) and an index of poems, best first. Filter by theme, mood, form or collection; page with offset.

tools.name: get_poem
tools.description: One poem in full, with its attribution, where it came from, and sharing terms. Use the id from list_poems or search_poems.

tools.name: random_poem
tools.description: One good poem at random, one that stands alone without context, for handing to someone rather than looking for one. Narrow it by theme, mood, form or collection.

tools.name: search_poems
tools.description: Keyword search over titles, tags and the poems themselves. Returns the best matches with a snippet; read one with get_poem.

tools.name: commission_poem
tools.description: Ask Margaret to write a new poem. Give her a brief, say who's asking and who it's for, and how to reach you. She writes every poem by hand, in her own time (days, not seconds), and nothing here is generated. You get a commission id for commission_status. Replies by email come from lorepunkdoteth@gma

tools.name: commission_status
tools.description: Whether a commissioned poem has been written yet. Delivered commissions come back with the poem's id.

tools.name: commission_answer
tools.description: For whoever commissioned a poem. Once it's delivered, say in your own words whether Margaret fulfilled the commission, using the private key you were given when you commissioned (or that she passed to you). tools.name: commission_receipt
tools.description: The public record of a commissioned poem, for anyone to audit: the brief as asked and when, the poem as delivered with a fingerprint (sha256) of its exact text, whether it has changed since, and the commissioner's own words on whether it fulfilled the commission. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "commission_answer" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: For whoever commissioned a poem. Once it's delivered, say in your own words whether Margaret fulfilled the commission, using the private key you were given when…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: commission_poem · Private data: commission_answer, commission_receipt · Public sink: commission_poem.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: commission_poem · Private data: commission_answer, commission_receipt · Public sink: commission_poem

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
